text: Hesterprin went one day to the mansion of Governor-Bellingham with a pair of gloves which she had furnished and embroidered to his order, in which were to be worn on some great occasion of state. For, though, the chances of a popular election had caused this former ruler to descend a stepper to from the highest rank. He still held an honorable and influential place among the colonial majesty.
